title: project.json
description: The entry document of an app envelope: its pages, their receipt files and the identity it requires. Hand-written; see envelope.md.

titleTemplate.description: How a page's title is composed into the document title: %s is replaced by the page title, %% writes a percent sign (receipt.md §1).

locale.description: The app's locale, a BCP 47 tag (en-GB): dates and numbers are written in it, and it is the shell's <html lang>.

origin.description: The app's public origin, scheme://host[:port]: a page's canonical address is this origin with the page's address (envelope.md §4).

image.description: The picture a link preview shows for the app (og:image): an absolute http(s) address or the app's own file, pwpack/media/<file>.

messages.description: The app's words: message id -> string, in its locale (envelope.md §2.1).

scripts.description: Third-party scripts the runner loads once the visitor consents to their category (envelope.md §2.2).

key.description: The script's name in the app, unique among its scripts.

src.description: The script's absolute https address; its origin is added to script-src.

integrity.description: Optional Subresource Integrity of the script (sha256-, sha384- or sha512-<base64>).

origins.description: The further origins the script reaches, by directive: exact origins, as a block's origins.

script.description: Added to script-src: scripts the script loads in turn.

consent.description: The consent category the script waits for: the script is loaded only once the visitor has consented to it (envelope.md §2.2).

notFoundSurfaceId.description: Key of the app's own not-found page; its receipt is in surfaceReceiptFiles, and it is not in surfaceOrder.

registration.description: Who may make an account, as the app declares it: the first frame's __auth.registration (pwapp-format 2.5).
